alignments.note: פֶּן is rendered by the negative purpose frame So that … not; the negation is what the morpheme carries and no other negative stands in this colon (rules 30, 35). Headed on the complementizer; heading on not was the competing reading.

The finite verb with its subject pronoun; level is the ASV's rendering of the פלס sense, as at v.21 maketh level. Light verb plus complement heads on the complement carrying the lexeme (rules 24, 44), which is how v.21 is headed: dropping findeth leaves the פלס sense standing in level, dropping level loses it. The competing reading marks level added, and heading on findeth was the reading this reconciliation corrected.
Construct noun with the supplied determiner rule 29 gives it, discontinuous around the attributive (rule 25).
Construct noun keeps its own word.
Finite verb recast as a predicate adjective with its copula (rule 20), headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
No conjunction morpheme stands in this colon, so the coordinator answers to nothing (rule 14's closing sentences); the ASV's italic corroborates it under rule 7.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun (rule 17).
Supplied object pronoun with no object morpheme in the clause (rule 44).

review_notes: The margin (Or, Lest thou find the level etc.; Or, thou canst not know them) was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
level was kept with תְּפַלֵּס on the strength of v.21's maketh level for the same root; marking it added was the alternative.

Chapter reconciliation moved this unit's target head from findeth to level, so that both occurrences of פָּלַס in the chapter head on the word carrying the lexeme, as rule 44 and v.21 require. The unit's source and target edges are unchanged.
